outcome: maternal hair essential trace elements and mineral levels (Cr, Zn, Na, K, V)
child hair essential trace elements and mineral levels (Mo, Se, V, Sr, Co, Cu, Mn, Na)
cohort: The study included 105 pregnant normal-weight women and 55 overweight and obese women in their third trimester of pregnancy, along with their children at 9 months of age.
finding: Maternal overweight and obesity were associated with altered hair trace element and mineral levels in both pregnant women (reduced Cr, Zn; elevated Na, K) and their 9-month-old children (lower Mo, Se, V; elevated Sr).
